messages:
alex: deploy-bot just flagged a p95 latency bump (+12%) on canary in usw2 and scheduled an autorollback in 10m. requesting ops hold/veto — any objections? link: https://internal.redwood/status/3057654321

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary p95 latency +12% vs baseline. Canary traffic: 3.1k RPS. Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK -> v2.9.1 in 10m unless overridden. Probable cause: recent kvcache kernel flag. See telemetry: /telemetry/canary/3057

mohit: saw increased tail for embeddings route too. not sure if same root cause but correlates with kvcache change.

sara: oncall currently. i'm available. prefer to hold 6m and collect a second sample before reverting. can we delay autorollback to 4m to give time for quick probe?

ops-oncall: +1 to hold for 6m. last rollback caused sessions to spike, want to avoid oscillation. we'll run a targeted probe against the failing route (embed-large) in the meantime.

alex: ok holding. operator window: wait 6m, run probe at +2m and +4m, if p95 still >+8% at +6m we manual rollback. notify customers if we rollback. sara you will execute?

sara: will run rollback if needed. prep steps: pin traffic away from canary, run `infra rollback --to v2.9.1 --pool canary --dry-run` first, then remove canary from routing and flip.

liz: drafting a short customer note in #status depending on outcome. prefer to wait until we decide.

alex: adding quick runbook snippet for the manual path:

```
# manual rollback (canary)
infra pin-set --pool canary --version 2.9.1
infra drain --pool canary --timeout 60s
infra rollback-exec --pool canary --from 2.10.0 --to 2.9.1
# verify p95 and traces
```

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorollback timer adjusted to 4m by operator override. Current timer: 4m.

mohit: running probe now -> `curl -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null -s https://canary.embed/health?size=large`  (starting 10 requests)

ops-oncall: probe1 complete: p95 samples marginally improved (now +9%). still above threshold but trending down.

sara: probe2 scheduled in 2m. standing by to run rollback if probe3 still high.

alex: decision timeline: if after 4m p95 <= +8% we let canary continue; if >+8% we execute manual rollback and pin; if autorollback triggers unexpectedly we will follow post-rollback validation checklist and post in #customers-status.

liz: note: release notes freeze until we confirm — Rachel in growth asked to hold the public blurb.

ops-oncall: probe2 results -> p95 back to +6%. looks like transient. recommending abort rollback and let canary continue with monitoring.

sara: confirmed. canceling manual rollback. running 10m watch and will escalate if it drifts back.

alex: thanks team. i'll update the thread that operator held and no rollback executed. liz please hold the customer note for now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ACTION: autorollback timer canceled by operator. Monitoring state resumed.
